verdict.rationale: Bevy's scripting language is Rust itself. Bevy is just a normal Rust dependency whose components and systems are plain Rust structs and functions, so game code sees the full engine API, with reference docs for its types and methods. Productivity is supported by 0.8-3.0s 'fast compiles' and hot-reloading of scenes, textures and meshes, though community comments question how productive the ECS style is and note thin docs. missing for 10: any evidence of a debugger or debugging workflow, hot-reload of code (only assets are documented), and independent corroboration of productivity.
